correctness.rationale: Two exact exhaustive traversal directions agree on the entire minimal set. The pair-first route gives zero reinforcement pairs below total 15 and exactly 18 at total 15, all split 5+10. The union-first route independently reconstructs every 15-voter union and every componentwise partition and returns the identical 18-pair set. The verifier also checks the three candidate-relabeling classes, eighteen distinct unions, three union classes, and the stated Condorcet-status structure.

value.rationale: Maximin is a canonical Condorcet procedure and reinforcement is a standard consistency axiom. Prior work emphasizes that its reinforcement failures are rare and that minimality is computationally nontrivial. A complete census of the first possible boundary, including symmetry classes, unique partition multiplicity, and Condorcet-status structure, is therefore a natural and motivated finite classification rather than an arbitrary slice.
